policy_sentinel.note: Policy Sentinel opens with its own empty search today and ignores extra address parameters. The policy_sentinel_url links carry the parameters proposed for a future release (scope, source, q, match, type, tribal, run), so they open the tool now and prefill once that feature ships. Checked against release 0.10.1.

searches.title: Tribal Energy Resource Agreement notices
